say:1:1710657001:1.source_cn: 这位大人，您的伤如何了？

say:2:1710657002:1.text: Ah, Miss Gwyneth! Oh, wh-what radiant fortune to be checked on by you personally!
say:2:1710657002:1.source_cn: 哎哟！原来是亨德里克司令的掌上明珠格温妮丝小姐！

say:3:1710657003:1.text: It's nothing, really. Just a little fall. All's well!
say:3:1710657003:1.source_cn: 我没事，只不过刚才摔了个跟头，还好还好！

choice_prompt:4:1710657003.text: It's nothing, really. Just a little fall. All's well!
choice_prompt:4:1710657003.source_cn: 我没事，只不过刚才摔了个跟头，还好还好！

say:5:1710657004:1.text: Magister Merlin! Yes, yes, thanks to your noble words back then, that whole fish affair finally washed clean!
say:5:1710657004:1.source_cn: 哎哟！梅林阁下！上次献鱼多亏了您仗义执言，我才能洗刷了冤屈！
say:5:1710657004:1.male: Magister Merlin! Yes, yes, thanks to your noble words back then, that whole fish affair finally washed clean!
say:5:1710657004:1.female: Magister Merlin! Yes, yes, thanks to your noble words back then, that whole fish affair finally washed clean!

say:6:1710657005:1.text: To even be invited to a royal hunt was already beyond my station... and then to suffer such a fright! My poor heart can barely keep up!
say:6:1710657005:1.source_cn: 这次能受邀参加行猎，已经是我莫大的殊荣了。可没想到……...
say:6:1710657005:1.male: To even be invited to a royal hunt was already beyond my station... and then to suffer such a fright! My poor heart can barely keep up!
say:6:1710657005:1.female: To even be invited to a royal hunt was already beyond my station... and then to suffer such a fright! My poor heart can barely keep up!

say:7:1710657006:0.text: Did you notice anything strange before the spider appeared?
say:7:1710657006:0.source_cn: 男爵阁下，巨蛛出现前，您是否察觉到了什么异常？

say:8:1710657007:1.text: Well... it seemed to appear out of thin air!
say:8:1710657007:1.source_cn: 这个……我只看到，那只巨大的蜘蛛怪物，就像是凭空冒出来...

say:9:1710657008:0.text: But your arrow, Miss Gwyneth, and your shield, Magister Merlin—marvelous! Truly marvelous! The kind of valor one only reads about in court chronicles!
say:9:1710657008:0.source_cn: 千钧一发之际，格温妮丝小姐那一箭的英姿，梅林阁下那坚不...
say:9:1710657008:0.male: But your arrow, Miss Gwyneth, and your shield, Magister Merlin—marvelous! Truly marvelous! The kind of valor one only reads about in court chronicles!
say:9:1710657008:0.female: But your arrow, Miss Gwyneth, and your shield, Magister Merlin—marvelous! Truly marvelous! The kind of valor one only reads about in court chronicles!

say:12:1710657010:1.text: T-then I must hurry to attend to him! One can't be absent at a moment like this!
say:12:1710657010:1.source_cn: 那、那我得去关心关心王子殿下！这可是天赐良机！两位尊贵...

choice_prompt:13:1710657010.text: T-then I must hurry to attend to him! One can't be absent at a moment like this!
choice_prompt:13:1710657010.source_cn: 那、那我得去关心关心王子殿下！这可是天赐良机！两位尊贵的阁下，我先告退！

choice:13:0:1.text: Let's go check on the Prince too.
choice:13:0:1.source_cn: 那我们也去关心关心王子吧
choice:13:0:1.male: Let's go check on the Prince too.
choice:13:0:1.female: Let's go check on the Prince too.

choice:4:0:1.text: You're the one who tried to gift the King...
choice:4:0:1.source_cn: 你是那个想给国王献宝的……
choice:4:0:1.male: You're the one who tried to gift the King...
choice:4:0:1.female: You're the one who tried to gift the King...
